A first-time joiner authenticates its Welcome with the authority's leaf credential carried in the room.invite: a credential that does not verify is refused not-authentic and records no pending join; the verified credential survives a restart inside the pending join; a Welcome from another leaf (identity naming another digest, or another leaf signature key) is refused not-authentic; the install roots the credential before the pending join ends

command.script_text:
#!/bin/bash
# usage: item20-tests.sh <ai worktree> <log> <cargo target dir>
# Runs the M-R2 item 20 named tests (-v, count=1) with the tree's own OpenMLS
# driver, built outside the tree; a skipped or missing test fails the run.
tree=$1; log=$2; target=$3
cd "$tree" || exit 1
export GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.11 GOFLAGS=-p=8 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$target"
EVENTLOG=(TestRoomCredentialsAreLearnedRootedAndRepeated TestRoomCredentialsStagedWithoutTheFusedWriteAreCollected TestRoomCredentialListIsAFailClosedRoot TestRemoveDeletesTheMembersCredential TestPendingJoinKeepsTheInviteCredentialAndTheWelcomeRootsIt TestRoomBufferHoldsObjectsOfUnknownCredentials)
DAEMON=(TestRoomRosterLearnRefusalsArePermanentOrRetried TestRoomApplicationOfAnUnknownCredentialIsHeldUntilItsRoster TestRoomApplicationOfAnUnknownCredentialIsRefusedAfterARosterWithoutIt TestRoomInviteRecordsAPendingJoinOnlyForAVerifiedCredential TestRoomWelcomeByAnotherLeafThanTheInvitesIsRefused TestRoomRosterLearnsCredentialsApartFromCardsAndSkipsFailingEntries)
GROUP=(TestCheckLeafBindsIdentityAndKey)
re() { local IFS='|'; echo "^($*)\$"; }
{
  echo "tree $(git rev-parse HEAD) status_lines $(git status --short | wc -l)"
  cargo build --locked --manifest-path messenger/rust/openmls-driver/Cargo.toml || { echo "rc_driver=1"; exit 1; }
  export TOS_OPENMLS_DRIVER="$target/debug/tos-openmls-driver"
  echo "driver_sha256 $(sha256sum "$TOS_OPENMLS_DRIVER" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  go test -count=1 -v -run "$(re "${EVENTLOG[@]}")" ./messenger/pkg/eventlog; echo "rc_eventlog=$?"
  go test -count=1 -v -run "$(re "${DAEMON[@]}")" ./messenger/pkg/daemon; echo "rc_daemon=$?"
  go test -count=1 -v -run "$(re "${GROUP[@]}")" ./messenger/pkg/group; echo "rc_group=$?"
  echo "status_lines_after $(git status --short | wc -l)"
} > "$log" 2>&1
missing=0
for t in "${EVENTLOG[@]}" "${DAEMON[@]}" "${GROUP[@]}"; do grep -q -- "^--- PASS: $t " "$log" || { echo "NOT PASSED: $t" >> "$log"; missing=1; }; done
grep -q -- "--- SKIP" "$log" && { echo "A TEST SKIPPED" >> "$log"; missing=1; }
grep -q "^rc_[a-z]*=[1-9]" "$log" && missing=1
echo "item20_result=$([ $missing = 0 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL)" >> "$log"
exit $missing
command.rule: go test -count=1 -v of exactly the named tests, with TOS_OPENMLS_DRIVER set to the tree's own OpenMLS driver (cargo build --locked, target outside the tree); a named test that is missing, skipped or failed fails the run
